name: SuperKitties
description: An adorable and action-packed new series about four fierce and furry superhero kittens — Ginny, Sparks, Buddy and Bitsy — who are on a mission to make Kittydale a more caring and ”pawesome” place.

videos.title: The Great Yarn Caper
videos.overview: The SuperKitties must figure out why someone is stealing all the yarn in Kittydale.

videos.title: Get the Boot
videos.overview: Lab Rat invents a giant boot to smush all the flowers at the Kittydale Flower Festival.

videos.title: Fireworks Fright
videos.overview: Mr. Puppypaws steals all of Kittydale’s fireworks.

videos.title: Cheese Trees
videos.overview: The SuperKitties have to stop Lab Rat from turning Kittydale into cheese.

videos.title: Silent Surprise
videos.overview: Zsa-Zsa takes away the Singing Squirrels' voices before a concert.

videos.title: Fufu Snafu
videos.overview: The SuperKitties have to stop Cat Burglar after he takes a gold statue from the Kittydale Museum.

videos.title: Super-Fan
videos.overview: SuperKitty super-fan, Pickles, helps the team save the day.

videos.title: Bubble Bother
videos.overview: The SuperKitties stop Zsa-Zsa from turning the Kittydale water tower into her own giant bubble bath.

videos.title: Groggy Groundhogs
videos.overview: The SuperKitties stop Lab Rat after she kicks all the groundhogs out of their special space.

videos.title: Go Birdy
videos.overview: On Kittydale Day, Zsa-Zsa uses a spray to make everyone in Kittydale act like birds.

videos.title: Blueberry Bonanza
videos.overview: Zsa-Zsa steals all the blueberries at the blueberry festival for her special cream.

videos.title: Snow Day
videos.overview: It's Bitsy's first snow day, and the team must stop Lab Rat from zapping away all the snow.

videos.title: Have a Ball
videos.overview: Tennis balls fly menacingly across a park in Kittydale.

videos.title: Zsa-Zsa Zoom
videos.overview: Zsa Zsa's minions steal a mini car from Peanut's master.

videos.title: Missing Mr. Greenie
videos.overview: Mr. Puppypaws snatches Bitsy's favorite toy.

videos.title: Piano Problem
videos.overview: When the abandoned piano Cat Burglar is playing suddenly gets damaged, he takes one from two musicians who are about to perform on stage.

videos.title: Treat Truck Trouble
videos.overview: All the pet food in Kittydale is replaced with dog food.

videos.title: Leapin' Laser
videos.overview: Lab Rat tries to rid the city of its feline inhabitants by using a device similar to a laser pointer which cats are unable to resist.

videos.title: Toy-Tastrophe
videos.overview: The dogs in Kittydale are having their toys stealthily taken away.

videos.title: Night Light
videos.overview: A power outage suddenly occurs in the city.

videos.title: Burble Bungle
videos.overview: Robots, disguised as kids' toys, steal cheese in Kittydale.

videos.title: Sticky Situation
videos.overview: When Mr. Puppypaws' fetching stick is snubbed by other dogs who see another one, he attempts to make a better stick with wood from the park.

videos.title: Lab Rat Lift-Off
videos.overview: Lab Rat thinks the Moon is made of cheese, thus she attempts to hijack a soon-to-be departing rocket headed there.

videos.title: Rockin' Rockhound
videos.overview: The Superkitties are summoned to protect a new artifact at the museum.

videos.title: Hole Lot of Trouble
videos.overview: Mr. Puppypaws digs holes at a park, causing tremors that terrify some underground animals.

videos.title: Roboctopus
videos.overview: Sparks makes his flying gadget move faster than Bitsy, thus his comrade feels she has lost her value for the team.

videos.title: Bird Bop
videos.overview: Zsa Zsa takes control of every mobile phone in Kittydale so everyone in town will watch her music video over and over.

videos.title: Pickle Problem
videos.overview: Pickles makes up false emergencies so the SuperKitties will come to his picnic.

videos.title: Cat Tree Caper
videos.overview: Platformed houses and stands for cats in Kittydale are being taken in the blink of an eye.

videos.title: Showstopper
videos.overview: Mr. Puppypaws wants to have the Singing Squirrels to himself after hearing them rehearse but getting bothered by outside noises.

videos.title: Sparks vs. Sparks
videos.overview: The locals of Kittydale are most surprised when what looks like Sparks goes on a robbing spree in town.

videos.title: Poochy Playdate
videos.overview: Mr. Puppypaws lures most of the other dogs away from the park so he and Ms. Poochytail can have the place to themselves.

videos.title: Voice With No Choice
videos.overview: The animals of Kittydale are getting their voices replaced by musical instrument sounds upon being exposed to Zsa Zsa's new spray.

videos.title: Brother Battle
videos.overview: Buddy and Sparks fall out over a game disagreement, thus the SuperKitties struggle to stop Lab Rat's scheme.

videos.title: Lost Spark
videos.overview: Sparks is afraid to ride his Super Kitty Kit after being knocked off of it from a great height.

videos.title: Bitsy Bellyache
videos.overview: Bitsy eats too much cat treats, and develops a stomachache which significantly limits her actions when an emergency comes.

videos.title: Amara's Tiara
videos.overview: Buddy, out of fascination, dons Amara's head jewel before it suddenly goes missing.

videos.title: Furball Blooper
videos.overview: After Buddy uses his signature roll move in a mission, he finds out his suit is damaged, thus preventing him from doing the move again.

videos.title: Fruit Loot

videos.title: Howloween Cat

videos.title: Cheesenado

videos.title: Talented Troublemaker

videos.overview: The SuperKitties must stop whoever stole Abraca Dan's magic tricks.

videos.title: Vanishing Valentines

videos.title: Big Dig
